# Subway Seat for Adobe Swatch Exchange

An .ase swatch library per flavor, one named group of all 26 colors. Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and the Affinity apps all import it.

[Adobe Swatch Exchange](https://helpx.adobe.com/illustrator/desktop/manage-colors/use-swatches/share-swatches-between-applications.html) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/ase/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |

| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.ase`](Subway%20Seat.ase) | import it from the Swatches panel menu: Illustrator › Open Swatch Library › Other Library…, Photoshop › Import Swatches…, InDesign › Load Swatches…, Affinity › Import Palette… |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in the Swatches panel menu:

```text
Illustrator: Open Swatch Library › Other Library… › Subway Seat.ase
Photoshop: Import Swatches… › Subway Seat.ase
InDesign: Load Swatches… › Subway Seat.ase
Affinity: Import Palette… › Subway Seat.ase
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in the Swatches panel menu:
